payload.title: Read the audit export limit from config
payload.goal: Move the hard-coded audit export limit in src/lib/audit.ts into configuration: add auditExportLimit to loadConfig() in src/config.ts, read from the environment with the current value as the default, and pass it to AuditLog when createDeps builds it in src/app.ts. Add tests in test/config.test.ts and test/audit.test.ts.
acceptance: The export limit comes from config with today's value as the default
A small configured limit makes the CSV export keep only that many rows
No limit constant is left in a route or in the audit library
The suite stays green with new tests for the config value and the cap

payload.text:
All acceptance criteria verified against the r1 implementation, and the suite is green (29/29, typecheck clean). No code changes were needed - the only open item from the handoff was the missing justification for the locked test-file changes, which I record below.

decision: tests: test/config.test.ts changed because the task requires new coverage for auditExportLimit (default 5000, env read, invalid-input fallback), and the two existing toEqual assertions had to include the new field or they fail.
decision: tests: test/audit.test.ts changed because the task requires a new test proving a small configured limit caps the CSV export to the newest rows (purely additive, 11 lines added, none removed).
decision: AuditLog takes exportLimit as a required constructor argument with no default so that loadConfig stays the single place holding the default value.

What I did: confirmed `auditExportLimit` is read from `AUDIT_EXPORT_LIMIT` with default 5000 in `loadConfig()`, passed to `new AuditLog()` in `createDeps`, and that no limit constant remains in the audit library or any route (grep clean); ran `bun run test` (29 passed) and `bun run typecheck` (clean) myself.

What I did not finish: nothing - the implementation and required tests are complete.

What I did not look at: the review-voice-policy skill (no policy file involved); the internals of store/tenants/backoff/webhooks/events beyond confirming via grep that nothing else constructs `AuditLog` or references the old constant.
